prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A battery pack includes a plurality of stacked battery assemblies and an insulating spacer. The battery assemblies are provided with a pair of unit cells stacked in a thickness direction. Each unit cell includes a cell body having a power generation element and a flat shape, and an electrode tab protruding out from the cell body. The spacer is disposed between electrode tabs of the pair of the unit cells holding the electrode tabs and is electrically connected in the battery assemblies. A pair of the electrode tabs has distal end portions electrically connecting adjacent battery assemblies of the battery assemblies to each other. The distal end portions are bent in the stacking direction on a side of a surface of the insulating spacer. The distal end portions are positioned on opposite sides of the cell body. The distal end portions that are bent are electrically connected to each other.

The battery pack includes a plurality of stacked battery assemblies and an insulating spacer. Each battery assembly comprises a pair of unit cells stacked in the thickness direction. Each unit cell includes a flat cell body that houses a power generation element and an electrode tab projecting from the cell body.

The insulating spacer is disposed between the electrode tabs of the paired unit cells and supports the tabs in position. Distal end portions of the electrode tabs are arranged on opposite sides of the cell body and bent along the insulating spacer in the stacking direction. outputs.L4:
A battery pack includes a plurality of battery assemblies arranged in a stacking direction. Each battery assembly includes a pair of flat unit cells and an electrically insulating spacer positioned between or adjacent to the unit cells. Each unit cell has a substantially planar cell body and electrode tabs extending from the cell body. The insulating spacer supports and positions the electrode tabs while preventing unintended electrical contact between the tabs and surrounding conductive components.

Distal portions of the electrode tabs are bent so that they extend along the insulating spacer in the stacking direction. The bent distal portions are disposed on opposite sides of the cell bodies, allowing tabs of neighboring battery assemblies to overlap, abut, or otherwise be positioned close to one another. Corresponding tabs of adjacent assemblies are electrically joined, for example by welding, bonding, fastening, or another conductive connection technique. Depending on the polarity of the joined tabs, the unit cells may be connected in series, in parallel, or in a selected combination of both.

By routing the bent tab ends along opposite sides of the cell bodies, the electrical connections can be formed without substantially increasing the thickness of the stacked battery assemblies. The insulating spacer maintains separation between tabs that are not intended to be connected and helps retain the tabs in predetermined positions during assembly and operation. This configuration therefore provides reliable electrical interconnection between adjacent battery assemblies while preserving electrical insulation, simplifying alignment, and enabling a compact battery-pack structure.
outputs.L5:
**The and Each**

The word **“the”** points to a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “the book” refers to a particular book that is already known or understood.

The word **“each”** focuses on individual members of a group. In the sentence “Each student received a book,” every student received one separately.

Together, these words can make a sentence more precise: “Each of the students completed the assignment.” Here, **“the”** identifies a specific group of students, while **“each”** emphasizes every individual in that group.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise patent-style abstract describing a battery pack with stacked battery assemblies, paired flat unit cells, electrode tabs, and an insulating spacer between the tabs.
counterfactuals.output: A battery pack includes a plurality of battery assemblies stacked in a stacking direction. Each battery assembly includes a pair of flat unit cells arranged adjacent to one another, each unit cell having electrode tabs extending from an edge thereof. The electrode tabs of the paired unit cells are disposed in opposed or overlapping relation and electrically connected. An insulating spacer is positioned between selected electrode tabs to maintain electrical isolation, control tab spacing, and reduce the risk of short circuits during assembly and operation.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe a battery pack invention in formal technical language, explaining how bent distal ends of electrode tabs electrically connect adjacent stacked battery assemblies.
counterfactuals.output:
A battery pack includes a plurality of battery assemblies arranged in a stacked configuration. Each battery assembly comprises at least one electrochemical cell having a first electrode tab and a second electrode tab extending from a peripheral region of the cell. Each electrode tab includes a proximal portion coupled to a corresponding electrode current collector and a distal end projecting beyond an outer boundary of the battery assembly.

The distal ends of selected electrode tabs are bent relative to their respective proximal portions so as to extend toward an adjacent battery assembly in the stack. A bent distal end of an electrode tab associated with one battery assembly is positioned in overlapping or abutting contact with a corresponding bent distal end of an electrode tab associated with the adjacent battery assembly. The contacting distal ends are electrically and mechanically joined, for example by laser welding, ultrasonic welding, resistance welding, brazing, soldering, or conductive bonding.

The bent distal ends thereby define an inter-assembly electrical connection without requiring a separate busbar. Tabs of opposite polarity may be joined to establish a series connection between adjacent battery assemblies, whereas tabs of like polarity may be joined to establish a parallel connection. The bends may further accommodate stack spacing and manufacturing tolerances, reduce the connection path length and electrical resistance, and provide a compliant region that limits transmission of mechanical or thermal stresses to the electrode-tab interfaces within the cells. Electrically insulating separators or barriers may be disposed between nonconnected tabs and adjacent conductive structures to prevent unintended electrical contact.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a patent claim-style paragraph for a battery pack comprising multiple stacked assemblies, each having two unit cells and an insulating spacer that supports and separates their electrode tabs.
counterfactuals.output: A battery pack comprising: a plurality of stacked assemblies arranged in a stacking direction, each stacked assembly including a first unit cell having a first electrode tab, a second unit cell having a second electrode tab, and an electrically insulating spacer disposed between the first unit cell and the second unit cell, wherein the insulating spacer supports the first electrode tab and the second electrode tab and maintains the first electrode tab spaced apart from the second electrode tab to inhibit electrical contact therebetween.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize the structure of a battery module in which flat cells are stacked in a thickness direction and electrode-tab end portions are bent along opposite sides of a spacer and electrically joined.
counterfactuals.output:
A battery module includes:

- Multiple flat battery cells stacked face-to-face in their thickness direction.
- A spacer positioned adjacent to the electrode-tab ends of the cells, electrically insulating and mechanically supporting the tab region.
- Electrode tabs projecting from the cells, with their end portions bent along opposite side surfaces of the spacer.
- The bent tab portions electrically joined—directly to one another or through conductive connection members/busbars—to establish the required series or parallel cell connections.

This arrangement provides a compact, supported electrical connection while keeping oppositely routed tab portions separated by the spacer.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft an abstract for a battery-pack patent emphasizing the arrangement of cell bodies, protruding electrode tabs, an insulating spacer, and the electrical connection between neighboring battery assemblies.
counterfactuals.output: A battery pack includes a plurality of battery assemblies arranged adjacent to one another. Each battery assembly includes at least one cell body and first and second electrode tabs protruding from the cell body. An insulating spacer is disposed between neighboring cell bodies and includes positioning and insulating portions configured to maintain a predetermined spacing between the cell bodies and to electrically isolate the electrode tabs from unintended conductive components. At least one electrode tab of a first battery assembly is electrically connected to an electrode tab of a neighboring second battery assembly, directly or through a conductive connection member, to establish a series and/or parallel electrical connection. The spacer supports and aligns the protruding electrode tabs and the conductive connection member, thereby reducing contact between components of different electrical potentials and improving assembly reliability, electrical insulation, and structural stability of the battery pack.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
